chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام, that he said:
Water is to be sought during travel: if the land is rough, then one ghulwah, and if the land is level, then two ghulwahs. More than that is not to be sought.

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel, the state in which this ruling applies
key_terms.غَلْوَةً: the distance of one ghulwah, a limited measured range
key_terms.يُطْلَبُ: must be sought or searched for

ai.seo_question: How far must a traveler search for water before stopping the search?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the required extent of searching for water during travel before one is excused from further search. It sets different limits based on terrain, indicating a measured obligation in matters of taharah and worship.
